about_the_game:
Sanity is for the weak!

PLUMBUM is a retro top-down roguelike shooter where you'll have to survive the innumerable hordes of mooks and goons in the cursed corridors of this cursed game. Will you survive as long as you can, or will you die trying?

You make your own sandwich!

In this game, you'll strategically decide how to lay out each level through this insanely simple Tetris minigame! Be careful though to not get lost, the randomizer will still do its due diligence and set you up probably for a trap!

Simple enough: KILL or be KILLED

Plumbum has a dopamine and adrenaline rushing gameplay afterwards where you'll not only have to kill every single living thing in the floor, but also collect weapons that will aid you in smoothing up your bodycount, or collect powerful powerups that will aid you in getting those satisfying damage numbers up! Don't die though, because the experience is tough!

content_descriptors.notes: Pixel art depictions of violence and crude language
